result.title: FieldGuideRAG: Image-Grounded GraphRAG for Fine-Grained Recognition with Vision-Language Models
result.summary: We present FieldGuideRAG, a training-free GraphRAG method in which a vision-language model, or VLM, recognizes fine-grained species by comparing the query with real photographs stored on the nodes of a knowledge graph. Multimodal GraphRAG systems describe each entity in text, and text conveys little of the visual detail that separates look-alike species. Our graph stores one photograph on every species node and links each species to its relatives, its geographic range and its ecological facts. A frozen VLM verifies the query against the photograph of each candidate node. FieldGuideRAG fuses the verification scores with the range edge and answers questions about the organism from the fact edges of the verified species. On CUB-200, a Wikidata graph and four iNaturalist domains, the node photograph improves verification over the species name on every graph, while text descriptions add little. Verification of the candidate pool exceeds a SigLIP retriever by up to 16 points, the range edge adds 7 to 19 points on iNaturalist, and answering from fact edges is correct on up to 89.5% of 28,820 ecological questions. The verification scores also detect queries whose species is missing from the graph. Graphs, prompts and code will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 FieldGuideRAG：在知识图谱每个物种节点存真实照片并连接近缘、分布与生态事实边，用冻结 VLM 将查询与候选节点照片逐一核验，融合分数与分布边完成细粒度识别并据事实边回答问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以图像而非文本作为候选视觉证据、并用核验分数判断目标不在图中」涉及视觉证据筛选与停止/弃答决策，可为 LVR 的外部证据获取与弃权机制提供参照，但状态仍停留在检索与打分层面，需核查对 latent 推理的可迁移性。
